explanation: A plain sequence-to-sequence model squeezes the input into one vector, and attention replaces that bottleneck with a weighted sum of encoder states. A transformer encoder block is multi-head self-attention plus a position-wise feedforward, residuals and layer norm, with positional encodings because attention alone cannot see order. Self-attention mixes all positions in one step without recurrence (a decoder masks later positions, but that is a mask, not a recurrent step). Token embeddings are learned rows of a table, and similar tokens do end up nearby. A 1×1 convolution cannot mix positions, which is exactly what self-attention does; positional encodings add order, not mixing.
